summary.text: Phil Hart represents Idaho Senate District 2, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory, which lists a Kellogg, Idaho, mailing address.

paragraphs.text: The directory biography says Hart served in the Idaho House of Representatives from 2004 to 2012.

It lists a B.S. in civil engineering from the University of Utah (1980) and an MBA from the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania (1984), and describes Hart as a structural engineer and published author.
